jobs.title: Territory Sales Specialist - Turbo Machinery
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Territory Sales Specialist is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. You will be assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. You will find and develop sales opportunities and engage with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. You will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the Regional Sales Manager. In this role, you will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. You will engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. You will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, you will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. ASM Responsibilities

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

ASM Qualifications:

• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.

• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills

Informazioni sul ruolo

L'Area Sales Manager (ASM) è il principale rappresentante esterno di Sulzer ai nostri clienti. In questo ruolo, l'ASM rappresenterà correttamente e proattivamente Sulzer ai nostri clienti. Der Area Sales Manager (ASM) ist der primäre externe Vertreter von Sulzer bei unseren Kunden. Dem ASM wird ein geografisches oder produktspezifisches Vertriebsgebiet zugewiesen und ist finanziell für die Auftragseingangs- (OI), Bruttogewinnmarge (GPM) und Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) der zugewiesenen Bereiche für das Unternehmen verantwortlich. Das ASM findet und entwickelt Vertriebsmöglichkeiten und engagiert sich mit Kunden bei dieser Abwicklung von Aufträgen und bis zu dem Abschluss von Projekten innerhalb Sulzers. Das ASM wird die von der RSM festgelegten Umsatzziele verfolgen und erfüllen oder übertreffen.

In dieser Funktion wird die ASM Sulzer bei unseren Kunden korrekt und proaktiv vertreten. ASMs engagieren sich für Kunden und werden voraussichtlich Vorbilder für das Unternehmen in unserer größeren Sulzer-Gemeinschaft sein. ASM wird eng mit anderen Sulzer Turbo-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um folgende Bereiche zu berücksichtigen: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety und HR, um profitable Aufträge zu sichern, zu versenden und zu rechen. Als Vertriebsleiter wird die ASM auch die RES-Geschäfte (Pumps und EMS) von Sulzer verstehen, mit ihnen in Kontakt treten, fördern und vertreten, um eine vollständige Ergänzung der RES-Dienstleistungen in der Region zu bieten.

ASM-Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwickeln, verkaufen und behalten Sie alle Geschäftsverantwortung für die zugewiesene Fläche / Produktlinie - Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Verkaufsstrategien im Einklang mit den Zielen von Sulzer - Planen, unterstützen und überwachen Sie die Vertriebsaktivitäten innerhalb der Fläche / Produktlinie - Entwickeln und liefern Sie technisch und kommerziell überlegene Vorschläge für den Kunden - Unterstützen Sie alle Geschäftsaktivitäten mit dem Kunden durch Abschluss und Rechnungsstellung - Entwickeln, pflegen und melden Sie genaue Umsatzprognosen - Überprüfen Sie RFPs, Verträge, POs und Bedingungen für alle Unternehmen

Möglichkeiten - Steuern Sie alle Geschäftskosten, als ob sie Ihre eigenen wären - Befähigen Sie sich mit und pflegen Salesforce: Chancen, Ausfälle Tracking und Marktbedingungen Ereignisse, Trip Call Reports und Wettbewerbs-Updates - Koordination, planen, teilnehmen und durchführen Werbe-Messeveranstaltungen - Nehmen Sie an vierteljährlichen Verkaufsanrufe oder Sitzungen mit dem Management-Team - Diese Position erfordert und erwartet häufige Reisen in die zugewiesene Fläche.

- Unterstützung von strategischen Initiativen von Sulzer in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Wirtschaft, Ethik und Qualität. - Präsentieren Sie eine positive, proaktive, professionelle Haltung und den Auftritt zu jeder Zeit.

ASM-Qualifikationen:

- Hohe persönliche Standards des Charakters. Muss einwandfreie moralische und ethische Verhalten. - Bachelor,s Abschluss in Engineering oder Business wird bevorzugt. Stattdessen wird der Kandidat mindestens 5 Jahre Branchenwissen und Erfahrung mit Turbomaschinen haben. - Frühere Erfahrung der proaktiv beeinflussen oder schließen Geschäft mit Kunden, Mitarbeiter und / oder kommerziellen Peers. - Kommerzielle und technische Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, um die externe Verkaufsposition zu erfüllen.

- Ausführliche Kenntnisse der Turbomaschinen und Sulzer, komplette Produktlinie - Muss in der Lage sein, technische und kommerzielle Dokumente zu verstehen, zu interpretieren und zu diskutieren. - Starke mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, Mikrodetails und Makrosituationen zu lesen, zu schreiben und zu diskutieren, sowie die zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten, um mit Personal aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen auf allen Ebenen unserer Kundenorganisation zu interagieren. - Bereitschaft, häufig zu reisen und das Geschäft als Ergebnis zurück zu bringen.

- Die ASM ist eine Führungsposition, die starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit erfordert, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu priorisieren und zu verwalten sowie die Fähigkeit, bereitwillig mit anspruchsvollen Fristen zu arbeiten - Diese Position erfordert und fordert außergewöhnliche Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten - Verständnis der grundlegenden Abschlüsse - Kompetenz oder die Fähigkeit, schnell lernen, wie man u

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Är du en lösningsorienterad person som trivs med tekniska utmaningar och vill bidra till en mer hållbar framtid?

Hos oss får du en varierande och utvecklande roll inom vattenrening, där du arbetar ute hos våra kunder tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor. Du kommer att möta nya utmaningar varje dag, lösa tekniska problem och bidra till att skapa långsiktiga och hållbara lösningar som gör skillnad för både kunder och miljö. På Nordic Water Products AB ligger fokuset på vattenrening och arbetet som servicetekniker utförs ute på plats hos våra kunder där Nordic Waters produkter finns representerade, både på kommunala renings- och vattenverk samt hos olika processindustrier.

I ditt uppdrag som servicetekniker ingår planerat förebyggande underhåll på våra egna produkter samt att hantera oplanerade reparationer. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Business Excellence / Development Sr. Expert is responsible for driving strategic planning and operational improvement initiatives across the organization. This role applies deep subject matter expertise to identify growth opportunities, optimize business processes, and align operations with corporate goals. The position plays a key role in managing large-scale projects and mentoring junior professionals.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Lead the Americas Business Development & Sales Operations organization, including business intelligence, CRM governance, sales process management, installed-base development, forecasting, and commercial analytics.

• Drive regional business development initiatives focused on new account acquisition, white-space opportunities, emerging applications, geographic expansion, and strategic growth markets.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of Sulzer and OEM-X installed base opportunities across the Americas.

• Establish systems and processes to track customer turnarounds (STOs), revamps, expansions, debottlenecking projects and maintenance cycles.

• Own CRM governance, opportunity management discipline, data quality standards, and forecasting processes.

• Coordinate pipeline reviews, forecasting processes, backlog analysis, and commercial performance reporting.

• Develop commercial dashboards, KPIs, and business intelligence tools to support decision making.

• Support deployment of market-based pricing initiatives and commercial governance processes.

• Partner with Sales, APT and Service Operations teams to identify and prioritize growth opportunities.

• Conduct market analysis, competitor assessments, and strategic business evaluations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead, coach and develop business development, commercial analytics, and sales operations personnel.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or related discipline.

• MBA preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in business development, sales operations, commercial excellence, strategic marketing, or sales leadership.

• Experience within refining, petrochemical, chemical processing, LNG, gas processing, engineered equipment, or related industries.

• Strong understanding of CRM systems, forecasting, business analytics, pipeline management, and commercial governance.

• Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

What we offer you

• PTO and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401K plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Als unser neuer Rental Sales Support spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Unterstützung des Mietgeschäfts. Sie werden Teil eines Teams von neun Kolleginnen und Kollegen in einem wachsenden Geschäftsbereich und profitieren von Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die sich mit der Expansion des Teams ergeben. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Verwaltung der administrativen Abwicklung von Mietaufträgen von der Auftragserfassung bis zur Vorbereitung der Rechnungsstellung, einschließlich Auftragsbearbeitung, Dokumentation, Kundenkoordination und Statusverfolgung.

• Pflege und Aktualisierung von Mietpreisstrukturen und kaufmännischen Daten unter Sicherstellung von Genauigkeit, Konsistenz und Einhaltung der Unternehmensrichtlinien.

• Verwaltung der Miet-Stammdaten, einschließlich Anlageninformationen, technischer Spezifikationen, Verfügbarkeiten, Mietpreise und Datenqualität über verschiedene Systeme hinweg.

• Unterstützung von Mietgeschäft und Vertrieb durch Reporting, KPI-Tracking, Vertriebsdokumentation, Prozessverbesserungen sowie die Koordination bereichsübergreifender Stakeholder.
Was Sie für diese Position mitbringen sollten

• Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Vermietung, Vertriebsinnendienst, Kundenservice oder Vertriebsunterstützung, idealerweise in einem technischen, ingenieurwissenschaftlichen, industriellen oder mietbezogenen Umfeld.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen und Unternehmenssoftware sowie Erfahrung in der Pflege von Kunden-, Auftrags-, Preis- und Stammdaten.

• Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren.

• Ausgeprägte administrative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit hoher Genauigkeit und einem starken Augenmerk für Details.

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu koordinieren, Fristen einzuhalten und effektiv mit den Teams aus Vertrieb, Operations, Engineering und Finanzen zusammenzuarbeiten.

What we offer you

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Führungskräften im kommerziellen Bereich

• Einblicke in internationale Geschäftsthemen, Reporting sowie Vertriebskennzahlen und ‑auswertungen

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As our new Rental Sales Support, you play a central role in supporting the rental business. You are responsible for managing rental orders, maintaining pricing data and ensuring a professional and customer-centric service. Support as an important interface between sales, operations, engineering and customers They coordinate rental facilities throughout their entire life cycle – from the preparation of offers and order processing to delivery, take-back and invoicing.

The position combines commercial support, administration and data management in a dynamic technical environment. In doing so, you will help maximize the utilization of rental assets and ensure an excellent customer experience.

You will become part of a team of nine colleagues in a growing business area and benefit from development opportunities that arise as the team expands. Your main tasks and responsibilities

• Management of the administrative handling of rental orders from order entry to invoice preparation, including order processing, documentation, customer coordination and status tracking.

• Maintain and update rental price structures and commercial data while ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with company policies.

• Management of rental master data, including asset information, technical specifications, availability, rental prices and data quality across different systems.

• Support of rental business and sales through reporting, KPI tracking, sales documentation, process improvements and the coordination of cross-divisional stakeholders.
What you should bring for this position

• Professional experience in rental, sales, customer service or sales support, ideally in a technical, engineering, industrial or rental environment.

• In-depth knowledge in dealing with ERP systems and enterprise software as well as experience in maintaining customer, order, price and master data.

• Fluent German language skills in words and writing as well as the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

• Strong administrative and organizational skills with high accuracy and a strong focus on detail.

• Secure handling of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, for reporting, data analysis and documentation.

• Ability to coordinate multiple priorities at the same time, meet deadlines and work effectively with the sales, operations, engineering and finance teams.

What we offer you

• Close cooperation with experienced leaders in the commercial sector

• Insights into international business topics, reporting and sales key figures and evaluations

• Varied activities with a combination of administrative support, business support and process coordination

• Active participation in increasing efficiency within the sales organization

jobs.title: Product Manager Filtration – Media filter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions is a place where entrepreneurial minds grow. We are seeking a Product Manager for continuous backwash granular media filtration DynaSand/SuperSand) to shape the growth ambitions in treatment, a talent who is ready to take ownership and make a real impact.

We are in search of a proactive, customer-focused Product Manager to bring our proven granular media filter technologies to new levels. In this role, you will own the product portfolio and plan its future. Working closely with global and regional teams, you will ensure solution-oriented offerings and full commercial readiness across sales, operations, and application support.  Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Lead technology transfer and localize global solutions for regional market requirements.

• Define regional product strategy through market analysis, customer insights, and business planning.

• Drive commercial launches by coordinating cross-functional teams and go-to-market readiness.

• Enable sales success through training, pricing strategies, technical support, and sales tools.

• Act as the application expert, gathering customer feedback and translating insights into product improvements.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• A self-starter attitude with strong communication skills and a solid understanding of municipal , industrial water and wastewater treatment or similar technical solutions.

• Proven experience and expertise working with granular filtration products .

• Experience process engineering ,  project management, market-oriented business/product development and international work  within a water treatment sector.

• Ideally experience from Global Product Management, alternatively local product portfolio management, global/local business development, sales management or similar .

• Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization .

• Excellent written & verbal communication skills in English .

• Willingness to travel internationally .

What we offer you

• An exciting position with great opportunities to influence your role with varied and developing assignments. We have an open organization with plenty of career development opportunities and exciting challenges.

• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy in an evolving industry.

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits.

The role is based in Europe, working from one of the many Sulzer offices, preferably located in Spain, Italy, Germany or the UK

For questions, please contact the recruiting manager Erik Edvardsson on erik.edvardsson@sulzer.com .

Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement.

About the role

Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions is a place where entrepreneurial minds grow. We are seeking a Product Manager for continuous backwash granular media filtration DynaSand/SuperSand) to shape the growth ambitions in treatment, a talent who is ready to take ownership and make a real impact.

We are in search of a proactive, customer-focused Product Manager to bring our proven granular media filter technologies to new levels. • Lead technology transfer and localize global solutions for regional market requirements.

• Define regional product strategy through market analysis, customer insights, and business planning.

• Enable sales success through training, pricing strategies, technical support, and sales tools.

• Act as the application expert, gathering customer feedback and translating insights into product improvements.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• A self-starter attitude with strong communication skills and a solid understanding of municipal , industrial water and wastewater treatment or similar technical solutions.

• Proven experience and expertise working with granular filtration products .

• Experience process engineering , project management, market-oriented business/product development and international work within a water treatment sector.

• Ideally experience from Global Product Management, alternatively local product portfolio management, global/local business development, sales management or similar .

• Excellent written & verbal communication skills in English .

• Willingness to travel internationally .

• An exciting position with great opportunities to influence your role with varied and developing assignments. We have an open organization with plenty of career development opportunities and exciting challenges.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits.

jobs.title: Retrofit Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member

Responsible for identifying opportunities for Retrofit and upgrade projects and driving them through to timely delivery of order intake. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Acting as main point of contact and technical consultant to sales team or end user / customer for Retrofit enquiries and related activities for nominated region

• Support the Head of Retrofits with development of the overall regional strategy plan, sales plan and continuous improvement projects

• Developing the account/region plans for delivering growth of Retrofit opportunities in allocated sales territory using technical knowledge and customers market requirements as the drivers

• Responsible for driving initiatives within nominated sales territory to promote the identification of retrofit opportunities thru performing tasks such as technical Forums, health checks or asset reviews, customer visits, internal training sessions etc

• Support input to the Rolling Forecast (RFC) process for nominated sales territory in collaboration with regional sales and service managers / directors

• Ensure that effective client contact, relationship building, and management processes are in place to positively influence the client and create a pre-disposition to view Sulzer as the preferred source of supply and actively utilize the customer relationship management (CRM) system

• Maintain knowledge of market and industry trends, competitors, technologies, and leading customer strategies, especially in relation to the retrofit and re-rate business

• Produce and review proposals and support overall proposal process

• Ensure that handover meetings and documentation are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status

• Attendance at sales meetings and ensure that all relevant information from assigned area is available for the sales team

• Actively promote Retrofits though social media and other peer platforms – internally and externally

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as necessary

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

• 4 Years of relevant experience within pump industry

• Relevant experience within related industry – Upstream, Refining, Petrochemical, Pipeline & Power.

• Experience of executing and building strategies

• Experience of technical / consultive selling

• Knowledge of pump design, application, and selection

• Knowledge of general pump upgrades

• Technical report and proposal writing skills

• Must have good organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

• Must have valid driver’s license and passport and be able to travel internationally

• Strong Communication and negotiating skills

• 25%-50% travel

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

Informazioni sul ruolo

L'Ingegnere di Vendite è responsabile di sostenere il processo di vendita fornendo competenze tecniche, assistendo con dimostrazioni di prodotto e preparando proposte. Questo ruolo funziona a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri senior e i team di vendita per garantire i requisiti dei clienti sono soddisfatti.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse / verificate con un membro più anziano

Responsabile per l'individuazione delle opportunità per Retrofit e l'aggiornamento dei progetti e la guida attraverso la consegna tempestiva di immissione dell'ordine. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:

• Atto come punto principale di contatto e consulente tecnico per il team di vendita o utente finale / cliente per Retrofit richieste e attività correlate per regione nominata

• Sostenere il Capo dei Retrofit con lo sviluppo del piano globale di strategia regionale, del piano di vendita e dei progetti di miglioramento continuo

• Sviluppare i piani di conto/regione per la crescita delle opportunità di Retrofit nel territorio di vendita assegnato utilizzando conoscenze tecniche e requisiti di mercato dei clienti come i driver

• Responsabile delle iniziative di guida all'interno del territorio di vendita nominato per promuovere l'identificazione delle opportunità di retrofit per svolgere compiti quali forum tecnici, controlli sanitari o recensioni di asset, visite ai clienti, sessioni di formazione interna ecc

• Input di supporto al processo Rolling Forecast (RFC) per il territorio di vendita nominato in collaborazione con i responsabili regionali delle vendite e dei servizi / amministratori

• Assicurarsi che un efficace contatto cliente, la costruzione di relazioni e processi di gestione sono in atto per influenzare positivamente il cliente e creare una pre-disposizione per visualizzare Sulzer come fonte preferita di fornitura e utilizzare attivamente il sistema di gestione delle relazioni con il cliente (CRM)

• Mantenere la conoscenza delle tendenze del mercato e dell'industria, dei concorrenti, delle tecnologie e delle principali strategie dei clienti, soprattutto in relazione alla retrofit e alle attività di rivalutazione

• Proposte di produzione e di revisione del processo generale di proposta di sostegno

• Assicurarsi che le riunioni di consegna e la documentazione siano efficaci e si traducono in una transizione regolare da pre a post ordine

• Partecipazione alle riunioni di vendita e assicurarsi che tutte le informazioni pertinenti dall'area assegnata siano disponibili per il team di vendita

• Promuovere attivamente Retrofit anche se social media e altre piattaforme peer – internamente ed esternamente

• Aderisce a politiche, procedure e standard aziendali e dipartimentali

• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema di gestione EHS a livello aziendale che include seguendo tutte le politiche e le procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Supporta e collabora nello sforzo aziendale di Gestione della Qualità.

• Esecuzione di altri dazi se necessario

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o campo relativo.

• 4 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'industria della pompa

• Esperienza rilevante all'interno dell'industria correlata – a monte, raffinazione, petrolchimica, tubatura e potenza.

• Esperienza di esecuzione e strategie di costruzione

• Esperienza di vendita tecnica / consultiva

• Conoscenza della progettazione, applicazione e selezione della pompa

• Conoscenza degli aggiornamenti generali della pompa

• Rapporto tecnico e capacità di scrittura della proposta

• Deve avere buone capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di lavorare indipendentemente

• Deve avere patente valida e passaporto ed essere in grado di viaggiare a livello internazionale

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione

• 25%-50% di viaggio

Cosa ti offriamo

• 12 Vacanze a pagamento

• 15 giorni di tempo libero (PTO)

• Medico, dentale, visione, vita e disabilità

• 401K con 6% dell'azienda match

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• Programma benessere dei dipendenti

L'ingénieur commercial est chargé de soutenir le processus de vente en fournissant une expertise technique, en aidant à la démonstration de produits et en préparant des propositions. Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs supérieurs et les équipes de vente pour s'assurer que les exigences des clients sont satisfaites.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé

Il s'agit de déterminer les possibilités de réaménagement et de modernisation des projets et de les mener à la livraison rapide des commandes. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

• En tant que point de contact principal et consultant technique auprès de l'équipe de vente ou de l'utilisateur final / client pour les demandes de Retrofit et les activités connexes pour la région désignée

• Appuyer le chef des projets de rénovation avec l'élaboration du plan stratégique régional global, du plan de vente et des projets d'amélioration continue

• Élaboration des plans de compte/région pour la croissance des possibilités de rénovation sur le territoire de vente attribué en utilisant les connaissances techniques et les exigences du marché des clients comme moteurs

• Responsable des initiatives à l'intérieur du territoire de vente désigné pour promouvoir l'identification des possibilités de modernisation grâce à l'exécution de tâches telles que les forums techniques, les contrôles de santé ou les évaluations d'actifs, les visites des clients, les sessions de formation interne, etc.

• Appuyer les contributions au processus de prévisions glissantes (FBC) pour le territoire de vente désigné en collaboration avec les gestionnaires régionaux des ventes et des services/directeurs

• S'assurer que des processus efficaces de communication avec le client, d'établissement des relations et de gestion sont en place pour influencer positivement le client et créer une prédisposition à considérer Sulzer comme la source d'approvisionnement préférée et utiliser activement le système de gestion de la relation client (CRM)

• Maintenir une connaissance des tendances du marché et de l'industrie, des concurrents, des technologies et des principales stratégies de la clientèle, en particulier en ce qui concerne la modernisation et la réévaluation des activités

• Produire et examiner des propositions et appuyer le processus global de proposition

• Veiller à ce que les réunions et la documentation soient efficaces et permettent une transition sans heurt de l ' état d ' avancement des travaux avant et après la publication de l ' ordre.

• Participation aux réunions de vente et veiller à ce que toute l'information pertinente provenant de la zone attribuée soit disponible pour l'équipe de vente

• Promouvoir activement les améliorations par le biais des médias sociaux et d'autres plateformes de pairs – à l'interne et à l'externe

• Adhérer aux politiques, procédures et normes de l'entreprise et du ministère

• Soutient, coopère avec et participe au système de gestion EHS à l'échelle de l'entreprise, qui comprend le suivi de toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement. Soutient et coopère aux efforts de gestion de la qualité à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Exécute d'autres fonctions au besoin

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

• Diplôme en génie mécanique ou domaine connexe.

• 4 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie des pompes

• Expérience pertinente au sein de l'industrie connexe – En amont, affinage, pétrochimie, pipeline et électricité.

• Expérience des stratégies d'exécution et de construction

• Expérience de la vente technique / consultative

• Connaissance de la conception, de l'application et de la sélection des pompes

• Connaissance des mises à niveau générales de la pompe

• Compétences en rédaction de rapport technique et de proposition

• Doivent avoir de bonnes compétences organisationnelles, une attention aux détails et une capacité de travail indépendante

• Doit avoir un permis de conduire et un passeport valides et être en mesure de voyager à l'étranger

• Forte capacité de communication et de négociation

• Voyages de 25 à 50 %

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 12 jours fériés payés

• 15 jours de congé payé (PTO)

• Médical, dentaire, vision, vie et handicap

• 401K avec 6% de correspondance d'entreprise

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Programme de mieux-être des employés

jobs.title: HR Country Manager Sweden
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer Sweden to build the future of HR. Lead the transformation of HR foundations, harmonize practices across legal entities, and create a modern, compliant and efficient HR function supporting approximately 300 employees.
The HR Manager Sweden will lead the transformation of HR across Sweden. The role will modernize HR operations, harmonize practices across legal entities, strengthen governance and compliance, and build a scalable HR function that enables business growth while ensuring an outstanding employee and manager experience. Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Assess the current HR landscape and identify compliance, process, and governance gaps.

• Simplify, standardize and digitize HR processes, including modernization of the payroll.

• Build a data-driven HR function with measurable business impact.

• Build capability for the future.

• Ensure full compliance with Swedish labour law, collective agreements, and internal regulations.

• Partner effectively with business leaders during a period of change and transformation.

• Balance strategic thinking with willingness to personally execute operational work.

• Challenge legacy practices and implement sustainable solutions.

• Support organization in Employee Life Cycle stages with focus on talent attraction, employee engagement, performance management, recognition, career, and successor planning.

• Leading, coaching, developing, and motivating local HR team

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR

• Strong understanding of Swedish labour law, employee relations, personnel benefits. Hands-on in managing compliance cases

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• IT competency with varied ERP, payroll, and other digital tools.

• Fluent in Swedish and English.

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager AME
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Engineering Manager is responsible for managing experienced professionals across multiple engineering domains. This role ensures the implementation of short-term strategies and policies, and influences broader organizational practices through technical leadership and innovation.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees. Key Responsibilities
Engineering Leadership

• Lead the Americas Engineering organization under a One Americas operating model.

• Develop and execute the regional engineering strategy aligned with business objectives and growth plans.

• Establish engineering standards, design practices, technical governance processes, and engineering procedures across the region.

• Drive resource sharing, collaboration, and workload balancing across engineering teams.

• Establish engineering KPIs, performance management systems, and organizational development plans.

• Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineering talent.

• Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Promote standardization and engineering best practices across all engineering disciplines and locations.

Design & Product Engineering

• Lead engineering support for MTCS products, including trays, structured packing, random packing, internals, separation equipment, and associated mass transfer technologies.

• Oversee product design, customization, validation, engineering calculations, and technical documentation activities.

• Ensure engineering deliverables, including approval drawings, fabrication drawings, bills of material, and design calculations, meet customer and Sulzer requirements.

• Establish design review and engineering approval processes across the region.

• Drive standardization, modularization, and design optimization initiatives.

• Support manufacturability improvements, quality enhancement, material optimization, and cost reduction efforts.

• Ensure compliance with customer specifications, engineering standards, applicable codes, and internal requirements.

• Support development of new products, product improvements, and engineering innovation initiatives.

Application Engineering & Commercial Support

• Partner with Sales, Business Development, Product Management, and APT teams to support strategic opportunities and key customer pursuits.

• Provide technical leadership during proposal development, customer presentations, and technical clarification meetings.

• Participate in project kick-off meetings and customer technical reviews.

• Ensure technical solutions align with customer requirements and MTCS capabilities.

• Improve proposal quality, consistency, responsiveness, and technical competitiveness.

• Support strategic opportunities in refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, CCUS, hydrogen, sustainable fuels, and energy transition markets.

• Serve as the senior engineering escalation point for complex technical issues and customer challenges.

Project Engineering

• Partner with the Head of Project Management Americas to ensure successful execution of customer projects.

• Support project kick-off meetings, engineering planning activities, and technical reviews.

• Ensure engineering schedules align with customer commitments and project execution plans.

• Review engineering resource requirements and project priorities.

• Support technical risk assessments and mitigation planning.

• Ensure engineering deliverables are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

• Drive engineering change management and technical issue resolution processes.

• Establish consistent project engineering methodologies across MTCS Americas.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Sr. Engineering Manager è responsabile della gestione di professionisti esperti in più domini di ingegneria. Questo ruolo garantisce l'implementazione di strategie e politiche a breve termine, e influenza pratiche organizzative più ampie attraverso la leadership tecnica e l'innovazione.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a People Managers di 4+ esperti ai dipendenti di livello superiore. Principali responsabilità
Leadership dell'ingegneria

• Guidare l'organizzazione Americas Engineering sotto un modello operativo One Americas.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire la strategia di ingegneria regionale allineato con obiettivi aziendali e piani di crescita.

• Stabilire standard di ingegneria, pratiche di progettazione, processi di governance tecnica e procedure di ingegneria in tutta la regione.

• Guida la condivisione delle risorse, la collaborazione e il bilanciamento dei carichi di lavoro tra i team di ingegneria.

• Stabilire KPI di ingegneria, sistemi di gestione delle prestazioni e piani di sviluppo organizzativo.

• Recluta, sviluppa, allena e conserva talento ingegneristico.

• Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, innovazione, responsabilità, collaborazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Promuovere la standardizzazione e le migliori pratiche ingegneristiche in tutte le discipline ingegneristiche e le sedi.

Progettazione e ingegneria dei prodotti

• Supporto tecnico di piombo per i prodotti MTCS, compresi vassoi, imballaggio strutturato, imballaggio casuale, interni, apparecchiature di separazione e tecnologie di trasferimento di massa associate.

• Superare la progettazione, la personalizzazione, la validazione, i calcoli di ingegneria e le attività di documentazione tecnica.

• Assicurare i materiali e i calcoli di progettazione, compresi i disegni di approvazione, i disegni di fabbricazione, le bollette del materiale e i calcoli di progettazione, soddisfare i requisiti del cliente e del Sulzer.

• Stabilire processi di revisione del design e approvazione dell'ingegneria in tutta la regione.

• Guidare le iniziative di standardizzazione, modularizzazione e ottimizzazione del design.

• Supporta miglioramenti della manufacturability, miglioramento della qualità, ottimizzazione dei materiali e sforzi di riduzione dei costi.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle specifiche del cliente, standard di ingegneria, codici applicabili e requisiti interni.

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti, miglioramenti dei prodotti e iniziative di innovazione ingegneristica.

Ingegneria delle applicazioni e supporto commerciale

• Partner con i team Sales, Business Development, Product Management e APT per supportare opportunità strategiche e attività chiave dei clienti.

• Fornire leadership tecnica durante lo sviluppo delle proposte, presentazioni dei clienti e incontri di chiarificazione tecnica.

• Partecipa alle riunioni di kick-off del progetto e alle recensioni tecniche dei clienti.

• Assicurare soluzioni tecniche allineate alle esigenze dei clienti e alle capacità MTCS.

• Migliorare la qualità della proposta, la coerenza, la reattività e la competitività tecnica.

• Sostenere le opportunità strategiche nella raffinazione, petrolchimica, chimica, LNG, CCUS, idrogeno, combustibili sostenibili e mercati di transizione energetica.

• Servire come punto di escalation di ingegneria senior per problemi tecnici complessi e le sfide del cliente.

Ingegneria del progetto

• Partner con il capo delle Americhe di Project Management per garantire l'esecuzione di successo dei progetti dei clienti.

• Supporta incontri di kick-off del progetto, attività di pianificazione ingegneristica e recensioni tecniche.

• Assicurare i programmi di ingegneria allineare con gli impegni del cliente e i piani di esecuzione del progetto.

• Verificare i requisiti delle risorse ingegneristiche e le priorità del progetto.

• Sostenere le valutazioni dei rischi tecnici e la pianificazione della mitigazione.

• Assicurarsi che i consegnabili di ingegneria sono completati con precisione, in modo efficiente, e in programma.

• Guidare la gestione dei cambiamenti di ingegneria e processi di risoluzione dei problemi tecnici.

• Stabilire metodologie di ingegneria di progetto coerenti in MTCS Americas.

Produzione e funzionamento

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Management Director is responsible for managing multiple project teams and supporting the development and execution of functional strategy. This includes overseeing complex projects, ensuring quality standards, and influencing executive leadership.
This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3–5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1–3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Position Summary
The Head of Project Management, Americas is responsible for leading and standardizing project execution across MTCS Americas under the One Americas operating model. The role provides strategic and functional leadership for Project Management activities supporting engineered products, capital equipment, manufacturing projects, revamps, retrofits, and selected service projects throughout the region.
Reporting to the Head of Product Operations Americas and General Manager Mexico, the position serves as the regional Project Management Office (PMO) leader and is accountable for driving project execution excellence, customer satisfaction, profitability, cash collection performance, risk mitigation, resource utilization, and project governance across the Americas.
The role is responsible for establishing a consistent project execution framework across the region while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, in accordance with contractual requirements, and aligned with MTCS growth and profitability objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Project Management Leadership

• Lead the Americas Project Management organization under a One Americas operating model.

• Establish and maintain project management standards, governance processes, methodologies, tools, and reporting systems across the region.

• Develop a scalable PMO organization capable of supporting future business growth and increasing project complexity.

• Promote project execution consistency across the United States, Mexico, Canada, and Latin America.

• Establish departmental objectives, KPIs, development plans, and succession planning activities.

• Recruit, develop, coach, and retain project management talent throughout the region.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.
Project Acceptance & Execution Governance

• Establish project acceptance and order review processes across the Americas.

• Ensure customer Purchase Orders align with approved quotations, scope of supply, pricing assumptions, and contractual terms.

• Oversee project transfer from Sales to Operations and ensure execution readiness prior to project launch.

• Lead project kick-off governance processes and establish execution strategies based on project complexity.

• Ensure project scope, schedule, resource requirements, risks, and financial objectives are clearly defined at project initiation.

• Establish governance requirements for strategic, high-risk, and mega-project opportunities.
Project Portfolio Management

• Maintain visibility and oversight of the regional project portfolio.

• Lead project portfolio review meetings and regional project governance forums.

• Drive prioritization and allocation of project management resources across the Americas.

• Identify project risks, execution bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and resource conflicts.

• Support proactive mitigation strategies and escalation of critical project issues.

• Monitor project backlog health, execution capacity, and future resource requirements.

• Provide executive reporting on project portfolio

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Project Management Director è responsabile della gestione di più team di progetto e del supporto allo sviluppo e all'esecuzione della strategia funzionale. Ciò include la supervisione di progetti complessi, garantire standard di qualità e influenzare la leadership esecutiva.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a leader senior che sostengono lo sviluppo di strategia a medio-lungo termine (3-5 anni) per la loro area funzionale, e hanno la proprietà dell'esecuzione a breve-medio termine (1-3 anni) di strategia funzionale/direzione operativa. Richiede la capacità di comunicare con e influenzare la leadership esecutivo. Di solito gestire più squadre. Posizione Sommario
The Head of Project Management, Americas è responsabile per l'esecuzione di progetti leader e standardizzazione in MTCS Americas sotto il modello operativo One Americas. Il ruolo fornisce una leadership strategica e funzionale per le attività di Project Management che supportano prodotti ingegnerizzati, attrezzature di capitale, progetti di produzione, revamps, retrofit e progetti di servizi selezionati in tutta la regione.
Reporting to the Head of Product Operations Americas and General Manager Messico, la posizione funge da leader del Project Management Office regionale (PMO) ed è responsabile per la guida dell'eccellenza dell'esecuzione del progetto, la soddisfazione del cliente, la redditività, le prestazioni della raccolta di cassa, la mitigazione del rischio, l'utilizzo delle risorse e la governance del progetto in Americas.
Il ruolo è responsabile della creazione di un quadro coerente di esecuzione del progetto in tutta la regione, assicurando che i progetti vengano consegnati in modo sicuro, puntuale, entro il bilancio, in conformità con i requisiti contrattuali, e allineati con gli obiettivi di crescita e redditività MTCS.

Principali responsabilità
Leadership della gestione del progetto

• Guidare l'organizzazione Americas Project Management sotto un modello operativo One Americas.

• Stabilire e mantenere standard di gestione del progetto, processi di governance, metodologie, strumenti e sistemi di reporting in tutta la regione.

• Sviluppare un'organizzazione PMO scalabile in grado di supportare la crescita futura del business e aumentare la complessità del progetto.

• Promuovere la coerenza dell'esecuzione del progetto negli Stati Uniti, Messico, Canada e America Latina.

• Stabilire obiettivi dipartimentali, KPI, piani di sviluppo e attività di pianificazione di successione.

• Recluta, sviluppa, allena e mantieni il talento di project management in tutta la regione.

• Promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, collaborazione, focus del cliente e eccellenza di esecuzione.

Accettazione del progetto & Execution Governance

• Stabilire processi di accettazione del progetto e di ordinazione in tutte le Americhe.

• Assicurarsi che gli ordini di acquisto del cliente si allineano con quotazioni approvate, portata di fornitura, presupposti di prezzi e termini contrattuali.

• Superare il trasferimento del progetto da vendite a operazioni e garantire la disponibilità di esecuzione prima del lancio del progetto.

• Lead project kick-off processi di governance e stabilire strategie di esecuzione basate sulla complessità del progetto.

• Assicurare la portata, il programma, i requisiti delle risorse, i rischi e gli obiettivi finanziari sono chiaramente definiti all'avvio del progetto.

• Stabilire requisiti di governance per opportunità strategiche, ad alto rischio e mega-progetto.

Gestione del portafoglio di progetto

• Mantenere la visibilità e la supervisione del portafoglio di progetti regionali.

• Riunioni e forum di governance regionale del progetto.

• Priorizzazione e allocazione delle risorse di gestione dei progetti nelle Americhe.

• Identificare i rischi di progetto, i colli di bottiglia di esecuzione, i vincoli di capacità e i conflitti di risorse.

• Sostenere le strategie di mitigazione proattiva e l'escalation dei problemi di progetto critici.

• Monitorare la salute del backlog del progetto, la capacità di esecuzione e i requisiti delle risorse future.

• Fornire report executive su project portfol

Leadership en gestion de projet

• Diriger l'organisation de gestion de projet des Amériques dans le cadre d'un modèle opérationnel One Americas.

• Établir et maintenir des normes de gestion de projet, des processus de gouvernance, des méthodologies, des outils et des systèmes de rapports dans toute la région.

• Élaborer une organisation de BPM évolutive capable de soutenir la croissance future des entreprises et d'accroître la complexité des projets.

• Promouvoir la cohérence de l'exécution des projets aux États-Unis, au Mexique, au Canada et en Amérique latine.

• Établir les objectifs ministériels, les ICR, les plans de développement et les activités de planification de la relève.

• Recruter, développer, coacher et retenir les talents en gestion de projet dans toute la région.

• Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, de concentration des clients et d'excellence en exécution.

Gestion de l'acceptation et de l'exécution du projet

• Établir des processus d'acceptation des projets et d'examen des commandes dans l'ensemble des Amériques.

• Veiller à ce que les bons de commande des clients concordent avec les devis approuvés, la portée de l'offre, les hypothèses de prix et les modalités contractuelles.

• Superviser le transfert du projet des ventes aux opérations et assurer l'exécution avant le lancement du projet.

• Diriger les processus de gouvernance des projets et établir des stratégies d'exécution en fonction de la complexité des projets.

• Veiller à ce que la portée, le calendrier, les besoins en ressources, les risques et les objectifs financiers du projet soient clairement définis au début du projet.

• Établir les exigences en matière de gouvernance pour les possibilités de projets stratégiques, à risque élevé et à mégaprojets.

Gestion du portefeuille de projets

• Maintenir la visibilité et la surveillance du portefeuille de projets régionaux.

• Réunions d'examen du portefeuille des projets et forums régionaux sur la gouvernance des projets.

• Favoriser la hiérarchisation et l'affectation des ressources de gestion de projet dans les Amériques.

• Identifier les risques du projet, les goulets d'étranglement dans l'exécution, les contraintes de capacité et les conflits de ressources.

• Appuyer les stratégies proactives d'atténuation et l'escalade des enjeux critiques du projet.

• Surveiller l'arriéré de projets en matière de santé, la capacité d'exécution et les besoins futurs en ressources.

• Fournir des rapports exécutifs sur le projet portfol

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du développement commercial et des ventes en location (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als unser neuer Business Development & Sales Manager Rental spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle beim Ausbau unseres Mietgeschäfts. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Identifikation und Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, die Akquisition von Projekten sowie den Aufbau und die Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen. Als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb, Application Engineering und Operations stellen Sie sicher, dass kundenorientierte Mietlösungen erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt werden. Diese Position ist deutschlandweit im Homeoffice angesiedelt und beinhaltet regelmäßige Dienstreisen zu Kundenstandorten (Firmenwagen wird gestellt).

Die Position verbindet Business Development, technischen Vertrieb und Projektmanagement in einem dynamischen industriellen Umfeld. Dabei tragen Sie dazu bei, die Marktpräsenz von Sulzer auszubauen, neue Marktsegmente zu erschließen und nachhaltiges Wachstum im Rental-Geschäft zu erzielen.
Sie werden Teil eines internationalen und wachstumsorientierten Teams und profitieren von Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die sich aus dem weiteren Ausbau unseres Mietgeschäfts ergeben. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien zur Identifikation, Akquisition und Realisierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Projekte im Rental-Geschäft.
• Pflege, Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie Aufbau langfristiger strategischer Partnerschaften mit Industrie-, Infrastruktur- und Key-Account-Kunden.
• Beratung von Kunden zu geeigneten Mietlösungen unter Berücksichtigung ihrer technischen und kommerziellen Anforderungen sowie Koordination des Angebotsprozesses in Zusammenarbeit mit Application Engineers und technischen Teams.
• Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Identifikation neuer Marktpotenziale und Geschäftsfelder sowie Repräsentation von Sulzer auf Kundenveranstaltungen, Messen und Branchenevents.

Was Sie für diese Position mitbringen sollten
• Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Business Development oder projektorientierten Verkauf, idealerweise in einem industriellen, technischen oder mietbezogenen Umfeld.
• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in den Bereichen Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, der Projektakquise sowie in der Verhandlung von Verträgen und kommerziellen Vereinbarungen.
• Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis kombiniert mit starker kommerzieller Orientierung und der Fähigkeit, kundenspezifische Lösungen zu entwickeln.
• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und internen Stakeholdern.
• Selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einer hohen Kundenorientierung und einem unternehmerischen Mindset.
• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
• Reisebereitschaft von ca. 50-60 % innerhalb der betreuten Region.

What we offer you

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen technischen und kommerziellen Führungskräften.
• Firmenwagen zur privaten und geschäftlichen Nutzung.
• Die Möglichkeit, aktiv zum Wachstum eines strategisch wichtigen Geschäftsbereichs beizutragen.
• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit einer Kombination aus Business Development, technischem Vertrieb und Kundenmanagement.
• Hohe Eigenverantwortung sowie die Möglichkeit, neue Märkte, Kundenbeziehungen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten aktiv mitzugestalten.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

In qualità di nostro nuovo Business Development & Sales Manager Rental, giocherai un ruolo centrale nell'espansione della nostra attività di noleggio. Sei responsabile dell'identificazione e dello sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business, dell'acquisizione di progetti e della costruzione e del mantenimento di relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine. In qualità di importante interfaccia tra clienti, vendite, ingegneria applicativa e operazioni, garantite che le soluzioni di noleggio orientate al cliente siano sviluppate e implementate con successo. Questa posizione ha sede in sede in tutta la Germania e prevede regolari viaggi di lavoro presso le sedi dei clienti (viene fornita l'auto aziendale).

La posizione combina sviluppo aziendale, vendite tecniche e gestione dei progetti in un ambiente industriale dinamico. Contribuirai ad espandere la presenza di Sulzer sul mercato, ad aprire nuovi segmenti di mercato e a raggiungere una crescita sostenibile nel settore del noleggio.
Entrerai a far parte di un team internazionale e orientato alla crescita e beneficerai delle opportunità di sviluppo che derivano dall'ulteriore espansione della nostra attività di noleggio. I tuoi principali compiti e responsabilità
• Sviluppo e implementazione di strategie per identificare, acquisire e realizzare nuove opportunità di business e progetti nel settore del noleggio.
• Mantenere, supportare ed espandere le relazioni esistenti con i clienti, nonché costruire partnership strategiche a lungo termine con clienti industriali, infrastrutturali e key account.
• Consigliare i clienti sulle soluzioni di noleggio adeguate tenendo conto delle loro esigenze tecniche e commerciali e coordinare il processo di offerta in collaborazione con ingegneri applicativi e team tecnici.
• Effettuare analisi del mercato e della concorrenza, identificare nuovi potenziali di mercato e aree di business e rappresentare Sulzer in occasione di eventi per clienti, fiere ed eventi di settore.

Cosa dovresti portare per questa posizione
• Esperienza professionale nelle vendite tecniche, nello sviluppo del business o nelle vendite basate su progetti, idealmente in un ambiente industriale, tecnico o di noleggio.
• Studi completati con successo o qualifica comparabile nei settori dell'ingegneria industriale, dell'ingegneria meccanica, dell'ingegneria di processo, dell'economia aziendale o in un campo comparabile.
• Esperienza nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business, nell'acquisizione di progetti e nella negoziazione di contratti e accordi commerciali.
• Forte conoscenza tecnica combinata con un forte orientamento commerciale e la capacità di sviluppare soluzioni personalizzate.
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione, nonché un atteggiamento fiducioso nei confronti dei clienti e degli stakeholder interni.
• Modo di lavorare indipendente, strutturato e orientato ai risultati con un elevato livello di orientamento al cliente e una mentalità imprenditoriale.
• Conoscenza fluente della lingua tedesca e inglese, sia parlata che scritta.
• Disponibilità a trasferte ca. 50-60% nella regione coperta.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con leader tecnici e commerciali esperti.
• Auto aziendale per uso privato e aziendale.
• L'opportunità di contribuire attivamente alla crescita di un'area di business strategicamente importante.
• Lavoro vario con una combinazione di sviluppo aziendale, vendite tecniche e gestione dei clienti.
• Elevato livello di responsabilità personale e opportunità di plasmare attivamente nuovi mercati, relazioni con i clienti e opportunità di business.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer

About the role

As our new Business Development & Sales Manager Rental, you play a central role in expanding our rental business. As an important interface between customers, sales, application engineering and operations, you ensure that customer-oriented rental solutions are successfully developed and implemented.

This position is located in the Home Office throughout Germany and includes regular business trips to customer locations (cars are placed).

The position combines business development, technical sales and project management in a dynamic industrial environment. You will help to expand the market presence of S.U.L., to develop new market segments and to achieve sustainable growth in the rental business. You will become part of an international and growth-oriented team and benefit from development opportunities resulting from the further expansion of our rental business.

Your main tasks and responsibilities
• Development and implementation of strategies for identifying, acquiring and implementing new business opportunities and projects in the rental business.
• Maintenance, support and expansion of existing customer relationships as well as building long-term strategic partnerships with industrial, infrastructure and key account customers.
• Consulting customers for suitable rental solutions taking into account their technical and commercial requirements as well as coordination of the supply process in cooperation with application engineers and technical teams.

• Conduct market and competition analyses, identify new market potentials and business segments, and represent S & D at customer events, trade fairs and industry events.

• Professional experience in technical sales, business development or project-oriented sales, ideally in an industrial, technical or rental environment.
• Successfully completed studies or comparable qualifications in the fields of industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, process engineering, business management or a similar field of expertise.
• Experience in the development of new business opportunities, project acquisition as well as in the negotiation of contracts and commercial agreements.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills and secure presence towards customers and internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Application Engineer Rental (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als unser neuer Application Engineer Rental spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle beim weiteren Ausbau unseres Mietgeschäfts im kommunalen und industriellen Abwassersektor. Sie sind verantwortlich für die technische Bewertung von Kundenanforderungen, die Ausarbeitung von Angeboten sowie die Planung und Koordination von Mietprojekten. Als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Service, Werkstatt, Einkauf, Kunden und externen Partnern stellen Sie sicher, dass technisch fundierte, sichere und wirtschaftliche Mietlösungen erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.
Die Position verbindet technische Projektierung, Vertriebsunterstützung und Projektkoordination in einem dynamischen Umfeld. Dabei tragen Sie dazu bei, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, die effiziente Nutzung des Mietanlagenbestands zu unterstützen und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Rental-Geschäfts voranzutreiben.
Sie werden Teil eines engagierten Teams in einem wachsenden Geschäftsbereich und profitieren von Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die sich mit der Expansion unseres Rental-Geschäfts ergeben. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
• Technische Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei der Ausarbeitung von Mietlösungen, einschließlich der Bewertung von Kundenanfragen, der Erstellung technischer Angebote, Kalkulationen und Lösungskonzepte sowie der Auswahl geeigneter Pumpen-, Rohrleitungs-, Elektro- und Instrumentierungskomponenten.
• Planung, Vorbereitung und Koordination von Mietprojekten in den Bereichen Abwasserförderung, Bypass-Pumping, Bauwasserhaltung, temporäre Pumpstationen und industrielle Anwendungen, einschließlich der Abstimmung mit Kunden, Lieferanten, Servicepartnern und internen Fachbereichen.
• Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, Prüfberichte, Checklisten und Stammdaten sowie Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen, Standards und Flottenmanagementkonzepten innerhalb des Rental-Geschäfts.
Was Sie für diese Position mitbringen sollten
• Berufserfahrung in der Projektabwicklung, im technischen Service, Anlagenbau, der Pumpentechnik oder in Anwendungen der Wasser- und Abwassertechnik, idealerweise in einem industriellen oder infrastrukturellen Umfeld.
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Umwelttechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Fundiertes technisches Verständnis von Pumpen- und Fördersystemen, Rohrleitungen und Armaturen, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungen, Frequenzumrichtern (VFDs) sowie Sensorik und Messtechnik.
• Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Kalkulation oder Auftragsabwicklung sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse im Umgang mit ERP-, CRM- oder Angebotsmanagementsystemen.
• Ausgeprägte organisatorische und analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer strukturierten, eigenständigen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.
• Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen sowie die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu koordinieren.
• Hohe Kundenorientierung, Teamfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungs- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein.
• Führerschein Klasse B sowie Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands.

What we offer you

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Vertriebs-, Service- und Engineering-Teams in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld.
• Einblicke in vielfältige Mietprojekte innerhalb der kommunalen und industriellen Wasser- und Abwasseranwendungen.
• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit einer Kombination aus technischer Projektierung, Vertriebsunterstützung und Projektkoordination.
• Aktive Mitwirkung am Wachstum und der Weiterentwicklung eines strategisch wichtigen Geschäftsbereichs sowie attraktive E

• Technische Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei der Ausarbeitung von Mietlösungen, einschließlich der Bewertung von Kundenanfragen, der Erstellung technischer Angebote, Kalkulationen und Lösungskonzepte sowie der Auswahl geeigneter Pumpen-, Rohrleitungs-, Elektro- und Instrumentierungskomponenten.

Was Sie für diese Position mitbringen sollten
• Berufserfahrung in der Projektabwicklung, im technischen Service, Anlagenbau, der Pumpentechnik oder in Anwendungen der Wasser- und Abwassertechnik, idealerweise in einem industriellen oder infrastrukturellen Umfeld.
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Umwelttechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Fundiertes technisches Verständnis von Pumpen- und Fördersystemen, Rohrleitungen und Armaturen, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungen, Frequenzumrichtern (VFDs) sowie Sensorik und Messtechnik.
• Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Kalkulation oder Auftragsabwicklung sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse im Umgang mit ERP-, CRM- oder Angebotsmanagementsystemen.
• Ausgeprägte organisatorische und analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer strukturierten, eigenständigen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.
• Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen sowie die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu koordinieren.
• Hohe Kundenorientierung, Teamfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungs- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein.
• Führerschein Klasse B sowie Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands.

What we offer you

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Vertriebs-, Service- und Engineering-Teams in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld.
• Einblicke in vielfältige Mietprojekte innerhalb der kommunalen und industriellen Wasser- und Abwasseranwendungen.
• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit einer Kombination aus technischer Projektierung, Vertriebsunterstützung und Projektkoordination.
• Aktive Mitwirkung am Wachstum und der Weiterentwicklung eines strategisch wichtigen Geschäftsbereichs sowie attraktive E

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Specialist is responsible for managing quality-related projects and processes with limited supervision. This includes coaching junior professionals, conducting investigations, and ensuring compliance with quality standards.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Purpose of the job

To design, integrate, and sustain long‑term capability health across Sales and Operations by creating end‑to‑end capability systems that enable consistent performance, adaptability, and future growth.

This role is accountable for architecting (not just executing) frameworks for assessment, development, transition, and continuous improvement—grounded in real operational and commercial work and scalable across the region.

Main tasks and responsibilities
1. Capability Architecture & Design

• Design role‑based capability frameworks across Sales and Operations, including:
• Core capabilities

• Proficiency levels

• Observable behaviors and outcomes

• Ensure frameworks support progression and knowledge transfer over time.
2. Assessment & Diagnostic Frameworks

• Design practical, credible assessment approaches that reflect real job performance

• Ensure assessment outputs inform development priorities, role readiness, and transitions
3. Learning & Enablement Architecture

• Design learning journeys and enablement models that support capability progression, not just content delivery

• Define the right balance of on‑the‑job learning, coaching, and formal training
4. Transition & Progression Design
Design readiness and transition criteria for role changes, increased complexity, and leadership pathways.
5. Sales Excellence & Commercial Capability

• Apply capability design principles to Sales Excellence topics, including:
• Sales capability models aligned to growth vectors

• Enablement of value‑based and solution selling

• Sales manager coaching capability

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• BSc degree in Engineering, Technical Education, HR Development, or related field

• Having Minimum 5-8 years experience in technical training or competency development.

• Experience in implementing competency frameworks and managing trainer networks.

• Experience in consulting, business transformation, strategy

Competencies and Behavior required

• Performance management system operation

• Passion for workforce development and technical excellence.

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail in assessment and reporting.

• Ability to work across cultures and regions with adaptability.

• Familiarity with apprenticeship models and vocational education systems.

• Thinks in end‑to‑end systems, not isolated initiatives

• Comfortable designing frameworks that evolve over time Stakeholder management

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Architecture de l'apprentissage et de l'exercice en 2006 - Concevoir des parcours d'apprentissage et des modèles en 2006 qui appuient la progression des capacités et non seulement la prestation de contenu - Définir le bon équilibre entre l'apprentissage en cours d'emploi, l'encadrement et la formation formelle 4. Excellence en matière de ventes et capacité commerciale - Appliquer les principes de conception des capacités aux sujets d'excellence en matière de ventes, y compris : - Modèles de capacité de vente alignés sur les vecteurs de croissance - Enablement de vente de valeurs et de solutions - Capacité de coaching des directeurs de ventes
